title: All positive r are admitted for ROC without inferring QC
statement: Separate producer original_roc.py reports exact global rank-one convexity of UNCORRECTED J_r for EVERY realr>0. Left SO2 invariance reduces direction to e1 tensor(1,t),including projective limit;quartic polarization receives acoustic matrix via Jr_doubleprime(R). Four leading-minor identities are reconstructed overQ in BOTH r,t. In particular det=9r^4t^4 and third-minor positive factor B=[3t^2+(r^2-2r-2)/2]^2+r(r+2)(3r+2)(5r+4)/4. All minors strictly positive for finite t!=0;continuity earns PSD at acoustic axis and projective limit. Fourth-order angular contact t^4 means an earlier local continuation requiring positive SECOND angular derivative cannot be transplanted without new work. GlobalROC is not QC,strict axis curvature or a general-U closure. Checker is a separate producer-authored exact route,not a newly acquired independent scientific audit.
